note: Rewritten from the original description by Hill (1915), where the species was placed in Eutermes as Eutermes pastinator; nest and biology omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate head nearly black, body dull ochreous, wings smoky, body with wings 20.5 mm; soldier head rusty brown with a darker base of the nasus and a distinctly paler occiput; worker head pale ferruginous.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head rusty brown, base of nasus darker, back of head distinctly lighter; body ochreous yellow. Head rounded behind and tapering to the nasus; nasus with fine hairs and bristles at the tip, remainder of head with scattered long reddish bristles; palpi long, reaching the tip of the nasus; antennae 14-segmented, bases of segments 2–6 whitish, first segment long and cylindrical, segments 4–10 lengthening, 11–14 shortening; pronotum small and narrower than the head, wider than long, rounded in front and behind, anterior half upturned in the middle and fringed with long hairs; legs very long, femora sharply contracted at the base; abdomen small.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale ferruginous above; clypeus, thorax and legs very pale ochreous; remainder whitish. Head rounded behind, widest across the middle, arched behind the clypeus, with a pale median suture meeting a transverse suture, a dark ferruginous spot at each end of the clypeus; clypeus large and convex, divided by a median suture, lobed in front, apex bluntly pointed; labrum large, narrowest at the base and widening apically; mandibles short; antennae 16-segmented.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head nearly black; antennae, clypeus, labrum, palpi, legs and venter dull ochreous; thorax and abdominal tergites dark brown, sternites 2–6 with a dark spot at each end. Head hairy, rounded behind, summit flattened with a narrow median cleft; eyes large, round and projecting; ocelli large and oval; antennae 16-segmented, first segment long and cylindrical, second and third smaller, fourth short, fifth to fifteenth more slender, terminal elongate-oval; clypeus large and convex, lobed in front; mandibles stout, right with two sharp apical teeth followed by a shorter blunt tooth and a large serrated basal tooth, left with two apical teeth, the posterior connected by a long cutting edge to a third small tooth; pronotum wider than long and narrower than the head, anterior margin straight and slightly upturned in the middle, hairy; wings large and rounded, costal base yellow, remainder smoky, forewing media with 3 simple veinlets, submedian with 11 oblique veins, the first five stout. Body with wings 20.5 mm; body 10 mm.
